# Decision: a 200 g trial jar for Diwali
Confidence: medium
## Decision
Launch the 200 g trial jar at 149 rupees by 1 November, as a first-order option only, and keep the 500 g jar at 299 rupees.
## Why
- Voice A and Voice C agree a cheaper first try fits the 62% of reviews from first-time buyers.
- At 149 rupees against a cost of 61 rupees, the trial jar keeps a healthy margin (Voice C checked the cost from the brief).
## Where the council disagreed
Voice B warned that regular buyers may trade down from the 500 g jar. Limiting the trial jar to first orders answers that, so the decision goes against Voice B on the launch but keeps its condition.
## Risks
- Regular buyers switch to the small jar: limit it to first orders.
- Label costs run over the 25,000 rupees budget: print one label run first.
## What would change this decision
If 500 g jar sales fall in November against October, stop the trial jar.
## Next steps
- Owner: approve the label design this week.
- Print one label run within the 25,000 rupees budget and go live by 1 November.
- Compare first-time buyers on 31 December.
